"DECLARE @CURRENT_DATE AS DATETIME;
	SET @CURRENT_DATE = GETDATE();
	SELECT distinct  
	SBSB.SBSB_ID + ''00'' MEMBER, MEME.MEME_MEDCD_NO AltKey,MEME.MEME_BIRTH_DT BirthDate,MEME.MEME_FIRST_NAME FirstName,MEME.MEME_MID_INIT MiddleName
	,MEME.MEME_LAST_NAME LastName,MEME.MEME_SEX [Sex],MEME.MEME_SSN [SSN],SBAD.SBAD_ADDR1 Address1,SBAD.SBAD_ADDR2 Address2,SBAD.SBAD_ADDR3 Address3
	,SBAD.SBAD_CITY City,SBAD.SBAD_STATE [State],SBAD.SBAD_ZIP [Zip],SBAD.SBAD_PHONE [Phone],MEPR.PRPR_ID AffNum,MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT EffDate,MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT EndDate 
	,CAST(ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), [IR_CODESET_CD]) FROM [ODW].[DW].[IR_XREF_IR_CODESET_VALUE] WHERE CODESET_CD = ''PLN'' AND SRC_SYS_CD = ''FAC'' AND SRC_SYS_CODESET_CD  = GRGR.GRGR_ID),''(*)'') AS VARCHAR(100)) PROGNUM
	,CAST(COALESCE((SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), [IR_CODESET_CD] ) FROM [ODW].[DW].[IR_XREF_IR_CODESET_VALUE] WHERE CODESET_CD = ''MRKT'' AND SRC_SYS_CD = ''FAC'' AND SRC_SYS_CODESET_CD COLLATE SQL_LATIN1_GENERAL_CP1_CI_AS = GRGR.GRGR_ID+CSCS.CSCS_ID)
		,CASE WHEN SGSG.SGSG_MCTR_TYPE = ''TNMG'' THEN ''TNMGR'' ELSE SGSG.SGSG_MCTR_TYPE END) AS VARCHAR(100)) MARKET
	,CAST(ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), [IR_CODESET_CD] ) FROM [ODW].[DW].[IR_XREF_IR_CODESET_VALUE] WHERE CODESET_CD = ''PLN'' AND SRC_SYS_CD = ''FAC'' AND SRC_SYS_CODESET_CD  = GRGR.GRGR_ID),''(*)'')
		+ ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), [IR_CODESET_CD] ) FROM [ODW].[DW].[IR_XREF_IR_CODESET_VALUE] WHERE CODESET_CD = ''MRKT'' AND SRC_SYS_CD = ''FAC'' AND SRC_SYS_CODESET_CD  = GRGR.GRGR_ID+CSCS.CSCS_ID),''(*)'')
		+ ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), [IR_CODESET_CD] ) FROM [ODW].[DW].[IR_XREF_IR_CODESET_VALUE] WHERE CODESET_CD = ''PRD'' AND SRC_SYS_CD = ''FAC'' AND SRC_SYS_CODESET_CD  = GRGR.GRGR_ID+CSCS.CSCS_ID),''(*)'') --MBR_PRODUCT_CD 
		+ ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), [IR_CODESET_CD] ) FROM [ODW].[DW].[IR_XREF_IR_CODESET_VALUE] WHERE CODESET_CD = ''SPRD'' AND SRC_SYS_CODESET_CD  = MEPE.CSPI_ID AND SRC_SYS_CD = ''FAC''),''(*)'') --MBR_SUB_PRODUCT_CD 
		+ ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), [IR_CODESET_CD] ) FROM [ODW].[DW].[IR_XREF_IR_CODESET_VALUE] WHERE CODESET_CD = ''AP'' AND SRC_SYS_CD = ''FAC'' AND SRC_SYS_CODESET_CD  = GRGR.GRGR_ID+CSCS.CSCS_ID+MEPE.CSPI_ID),''(*)'') --MCAID POP CAT CD
		+ ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), [IR_CODESET_CD] ) FROM [ODW].[DW].[IR_XREF_IR_CODESET_VALUE] WHERE CODESET_CD = ''MCN'' AND SRC_SYS_CD = ''FAC'' AND SRC_SYS_CODESET_CD  = GRGR.GRGR_ID+SGSG.SGSG_ID),''(*)'') --COUNTY
	AS VARCHAR(500)) DIVISION
	,CASE 
      WHEN SBAD.SBAD_STATE = ''WI'' THEN 
      (SELECT TOP 1 ''WI''+[MCZT_COUNTY_NO] FROM [ODW].[DW].[FAC_CER_MCZT_ZIP_TRANS] WHERE [MCZT_STATE_ABBREV]=''WI'' AND MCZT_ZIP_CODE  = LEFT(SBAD.SBAD_ZIP,5) )
      ELSE
      CAST(ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), [IR_CODESET_CD]) FROM [ODW].[DW].[IR_XREF_IR_CODESET_VALUE] WHERE CODESET_CD = ''MCN'' AND SRC_SYS_CD = ''FAC'' AND SRC_SYS_CODESET_CD = GRGR.GRGR_ID+SGSG.SGSG_ID),''(*)'') AS VARCHAR(500))
	END COUNTY
	,CAST(CASE WHEN MEME_MCTR_LANG = '''' THEN  NULL ELSE MEME_MCTR_LANG END AS VARCHAR(500)) [LANGUAGE]
	,SBSB.SBSB_MCTR_VIP ETHNICITY
	,CASE WHEN YEAR(SBSB.SBSB_RETIRE_DT) = 1753 THEN NULL 
			WHEN SBSB.SBSB_RETIRE_DT IS NOT NULL AND SBSB.SBSB_RETIRE_DT > MEME.MEME_BIRTH_DT THEN NULL 
			ELSE SBSB.SBSB_RETIRE_DT END DEATHDATE
	,COALESCE (ATUF.ATUF_TEXT1, ''NOT SPECIFIED'') GUARDIAN
	,[SBAD_EMAIL] [EmailAddress]
	,MEME.MEME_FAM_LINK_ID [HOHFamilyLink]
	,GETDATE () [RunDate]
	FROM ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME 
	JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE  on MEPE.MEME_CK=MEME.MEME_CK and MEPE.GRGR_CK=MEME.GRGR_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = ''Y'' and @CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT and MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT
	JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB on MEME.SBSB_CK=SBSB.SBSB_CK and MEME.GRGR_CK=SBSB.GRGR_CK
	JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD  on SBSB.SBSB_CK=SBAD.SBSB_CK and SBSB.GRGR_CK=SBAD.GRGR_CK and SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_HOME=SBAD.SBAD_TYPE
	JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC PLDS  on MEPE.CSPI_ID=PLDS.CSPI_ID
	JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_PDDS_PROD_DESC PDDS  on MEPE.PDPD_ID=PDDS.PDPD_ID
	JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_CSCS_CLASS CSCS  on MEPE.CSCS_ID = CSCS.CSCS_ID and MEPE.GRGR_CK = CSCS.GRGR_CK
	LEFT JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR  on MEPE.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK
	LEFT JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_SGSG_SUB_GROUP SGSG  on MEPE.SGSG_CK=SGSG.SGSG_CK	and MEPE.GRGR_CK=SGSG.GRGR_CK
	LEFT JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEPR_PRIM_PROV MEPR  on MEPE.MEME_CK=MEPR.MEME_CK and (@CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN MEPR.MEPR_EFF_DT and MEPR.MEPR_TERM_DT) and MEPE.GRGR_CK=MEPR.GRGR_CK
	LEFT JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CER_ATXR_ATTACH_U ATXR  on ATXR.ATXR_SOURCE_ID = SBSB.ATXR_SOURCE_ID AND ATXR.ATSY_ID = ''RPD''
	LEFT JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CER_ATUF_USERFLD_D ATUF  on ATXR.ATSY_ID = ATUF.ATSY_ID AND ATXR.ATXR_DEST_ID = ATUF.ATXR_DEST_ID
	WHERE (MEPE.CSCS_ID like ''CD%'' or MEPE.CSCS_ID like ''PL%'' or MEPE.CSCS_ID like ''CO%'' or MEPE.CSCS_ID like ''FC%'' or MEPE.CSCS_ID like ''KD%'' or MEPE.CSCS_ID like ''CS%'' or MEPE.CSCS_ID like ''KS%'')
"

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT DISTINCT                SBSB.SBSB_ID + '00' AS MEMBER, 	SBAD.SBAD_ADDR1 AS ADDRESS1, 	SBAD.SBAD_ADDR2 AS ADDRESS2, 	SBAD.SBAD_ADDR3 AS ADDRESS3, 	SBAD.SBAD_CITY AS CITY, 	SBAD.SBAD_STATE AS STATE, 	SBAD.SBAD_ZIP AS ZIP, 	SBAD.SBAD_PHONE AS PHONE FROM ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB (nolock) join ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD (nolock) on SBSB.SBSB_CK=SBAD.SBSB_CK  and SBSB.GRGR_CK=SBAD.GRGR_CK  and SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_HOME=SBAD.SBAD_TYPE WHERE   SBAD.SBAD_TYPE = 'PMA'

EXEC ('DBO.PR_EPSDTCurrentMemberRefresh')     WITH RESULT SETS       (         ([Member] [varchar](15) NOT NULL, 	[AltKey] [varchar](20) NULL, 	[NewMember] [char](1) NULL, 	[BirthDate] [datetime] NULL, 	[FirstName] [varchar](35) NULL, 	[LastName] [varchar](35) NULL, 	[Sex] [varchar](5) NULL, 	[SSN] [varchar](12) NULL, 	[Address1] [varchar](40) NULL, 	[Address2] [varchar](40) NULL, 	[Address3] [varchar](40) NULL, 	[City] [varchar](100) NULL, 	[State] [varchar](3) NULL, 	[Zip] [varchar](10) NULL, 	[Phone] [varchar](20) NULL, 	[AffNum] [varchar](19) NULL, 	[EffDate] [datetime] NULL, 	[EndDate] [datetime] NULL, 	[ProgNum] [varchar](5) NULL, 	[Market] [varchar](10) NULL, 	[Division] [varchar](35) NULL, 	[County] [varchar](15) NULL, 	[Language] [varchar](5) NULL, 	[Ethnicity] [varchar](5) NULL, 	[DeathDate] [datetime] NULL, 	[Guardian] [varchar](75) NULL, 	[MiddleName] [varchar](35) NULL, 	[EmailAddress] [varchar](40) NULL, 	[HOHFamilyLink] [varchar](12) NULL,                 [RunDate] [datetime] NULL,                 [CSCS_DESC] [varchar] (70) NULL,                 [CSCS_ID] [varchar] (4) NULL,                 [Provider_TaxID] [varchar] (18) NULL,                 [Provider_Name] [varchar] (100) NULL,                 [Group_Name] [varchar] (100) NULL          )    )

DECLARE @JobId INT

SET @JobId = (SELECT JobId FROM EPSDTJob WHERE JobCode = 'SystemRefresh')

EXEC spCreateAppLog @JobId, 'JobRun', 'Update Current Members Address', 0, 0

UPDATE EPSDT.dbo.EPSDTCurrentMember_Stage SET 
 Address1 = P.Address1,
 Address2 = P.Address2,
 City = P.City,
 State = P.State,
 Phone = P.Phone
FROM EPSDT.dbo.EPSDTCurrentMemberPMALoad P
INNER JOIN EPSDTCurrentMember_Stage M ON P.Member = M.Member

CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX [IDX_Member_Market_ProgNum] ON [dbo].[EPSDTCurrentMember]
 ([Market], [ProgNum], [BirthDate], [AffNum], [Member]) ON [PRIMARY]

CREATE INDEX [IDNX_Market_ProgNum_BirthDate] ON [dbo].[EPSDTCurrentMember]
 ([Market], [ProgNum], [BirthDate], [AffNum]) ON [PRIMARY]

CREATE INDEX [idxOptAltKey] ON [dbo].[EPSDTCurrentMember]
 ([AltKey]) ON [PRIMARY]

CREATE INDEX [idxOptMember] ON [dbo].[EPSDTCurrentMember]
 ([Member]) ON [PRIMARY]

CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_EPSDTCurrentMember_ProgNum_LastName_FirstName_BirthDate] ON [dbo].[EPSDTCurrentMember] 
(
 [ProgNum] ASC,
 [LastName] ASC,

USE EPSDT
DECLARE @FirstDayOfMonth Datetime,
        @LastDayOfMonth Datetime,
		@CurrentDate datetime

SET @CurrentDate = GETDATE ()
SET @FirstDayOfMonth = CONVERT(VARCHAR(25),DATEADD(dd,-(DAY(@CurrentDate)-1),@CurrentDate),101)
SET @LastDayOfMonth = CONVERT(VARCHAR(25),DATEADD(dd,-(DAY(DATEADD(mm,1,@CurrentDate))),DATEADD(mm,1,@CurrentDate)),101)

UPDATE [dbo].[EPSDTCurrentMember_Stage]
SET [EffDate]    = CE.MEPE_EFF_DT,
    [EndDate]    = CE.MEPE_TERM_DT,
    [NewMember]  = CASE WHEN CE.MEPE_EFF_DT BETWEEN @FirstDayofMonth  AND @LastDayOfMonth  THEN 'Y'  END 

FROM [dbo].[EPSDTCurrentMember_Stage] CM
INNER JOIN [dbo].[EPSDTCMemberEligibility]CE
   ON CM.Member = CE.MEMBER
   AND CM.ProgNum = 'WI'

'DECLARE @CURRENT_DATE AS DATETIME;
	SET @CURRENT_DATE = GETDATE();
	SELECT distinct  
	SBSB.SBSB_ID + '00' MEMBER, MEME.MEME_MEDCD_NO AltKey,MEME.MEME_BIRTH_DT BirthDate,MEME.MEME_FIRST_NAME FirstName,MEME.MEME_MID_INIT MiddleName
	,MEME.MEME_LAST_NAME LastName,MEME.MEME_SEX [Sex],MEME.MEME_SSN [SSN],SBAD.SBAD_ADDR1 Address1,SBAD.SBAD_ADDR2 Address2,SBAD.SBAD_ADDR3 Address3
	,SBAD.SBAD_CITY City,SBAD.SBAD_STATE [State],SBAD.SBAD_ZIP [Zip],SBAD.SBAD_PHONE [Phone],MEPR.PRPR_ID AffNum,MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT EffDate,MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT EndDate 
	,CAST(ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), [IR_CODESET_CD]) FROM [ODW].[DW].[IR_XREF_IR_CODESET_VALUE] WHERE CODESET_CD = 'PLN' AND SRC_SYS_CD = 'FAC' AND SRC_SYS_CODESET_CD  = GRGR.GRGR_ID),'(*)') AS VARCHAR(100)) PROGNUM
	,CAST(COALESCE((SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), [IR_CODESET_CD] ) FROM [ODW].[DW].[IR_XREF_IR_CODESET_VALUE] WHERE CODESET_CD = 'MRKT' AND SRC_SYS_CD = 'FAC' AND SRC_SYS_CODESET_CD COLLATE SQL_LATIN1_GENERAL_CP1_CI_AS = GRGR.GRGR_ID+CSCS.CSCS_ID)
		,CASE WHEN SGSG.SGSG_MCTR_TYPE = 'TNMG' THEN 'TNMGR' ELSE SGSG.SGSG_MCTR_TYPE END) AS VARCHAR(100)) MARKET
	,CAST(ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), [IR_CODESET_CD] ) FROM [ODW].[DW].[IR_XREF_IR_CODESET_VALUE] WHERE CODESET_CD = 'PLN' AND SRC_SYS_CD = 'FAC' AND SRC_SYS_CODESET_CD  = GRGR.GRGR_ID),'(*)')
		+ ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), [IR_CODESET_CD] ) FROM [ODW].[DW].[IR_XREF_IR_CODESET_VALUE] WHERE CODESET_CD = 'MRKT' AND SRC_SYS_CD = 'FAC' AND SRC_SYS_CODESET_CD  = GRGR.GRGR_ID+CSCS.CSCS_ID),'(*)')
		+ ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), [IR_CODESET_CD] ) FROM [ODW].[DW].[IR_XREF_IR_CODESET_VALUE] WHERE CODESET_CD = 'PRD' AND SRC_SYS_CD = 'FAC' AND SRC_SYS_CODESET_CD  = GRGR.GRGR_ID+CSCS.CSCS_ID),'(*)') --MBR_PRODUCT_CD 
		+ ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), [IR_CODESET_CD] ) FROM [ODW].[DW].[IR_XREF_IR_CODESET_VALUE] WHERE CODESET_CD = 'SPRD' AND SRC_SYS_CODESET_CD  = MEPE.CSPI_ID AND SRC_SYS_CD = 'FAC'),'(*)') --MBR_SUB_PRODUCT_CD 
		+ ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), [IR_CODESET_CD] ) FROM [ODW].[DW].[IR_XREF_IR_CODESET_VALUE] WHERE CODESET_CD = 'AP' AND SRC_SYS_CD = 'FAC' AND SRC_SYS_CODESET_CD  = GRGR.GRGR_ID+CSCS.CSCS_ID+MEPE.CSPI_ID),'(*)') --MCAID POP CAT CD
		+ ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), [IR_CODESET_CD] ) FROM [ODW].[DW].[IR_XREF_IR_CODESET_VALUE] WHERE CODESET_CD = 'MCN' AND SRC_SYS_CD = 'FAC' AND SRC_SYS_CODESET_CD  = GRGR.GRGR_ID+SGSG.SGSG_ID),'(*)') --COUNTY
	AS VARCHAR(500)) DIVISION
	,CASE 
      WHEN SBAD.SBAD_STATE = 'WI' THEN 
      (SELECT TOP 1 'WI'+[MCZT_COUNTY_NO] FROM [ODW].[DW].[FAC_CER_MCZT_ZIP_TRANS] WHERE [MCZT_STATE_ABBREV]='WI' AND MCZT_ZIP_CODE  = LEFT(SBAD.SBAD_ZIP,5) )
      ELSE
      CAST(ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), [IR_CODESET_CD]) FROM [ODW].[DW].[IR_XREF_IR_CODESET_VALUE] WHERE CODESET_CD = 'MCN' AND SRC_SYS_CD = 'FAC' AND SRC_SYS_CODESET_CD = GRGR.GRGR_ID+SGSG.SGSG_ID),'(*)') AS VARCHAR(500))
	END COUNTY
	,CAST(CASE WHEN MEME_MCTR_LANG = '' THEN  NULL ELSE MEME_MCTR_LANG END AS VARCHAR(500)) [LANGUAGE]
	,SBSB.SBSB_MCTR_VIP ETHNICITY
	,CASE WHEN YEAR(SBSB.SBSB_RETIRE_DT) = 1753 THEN NULL 
			WHEN SBSB.SBSB_RETIRE_DT IS NOT NULL AND SBSB.SBSB_RETIRE_DT > MEME.MEME_BIRTH_DT THEN NULL 
			ELSE SBSB.SBSB_RETIRE_DT END DEATHDATE
	,COALESCE (ATUF.ATUF_TEXT1, 'NOT SPECIFIED') GUARDIAN
	,[SBAD_EMAIL] [EmailAddress]
	,MEME.MEME_FAM_LINK_ID [HOHFamilyLink]
	,GETDATE () [RunDate]
	FROM ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME 
	JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE  on MEPE.MEME_CK=MEME.MEME_CK and MEPE.GRGR_CK=MEME.GRGR_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y' and @CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT and MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT
	JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB on MEME.SBSB_CK=SBSB.SBSB_CK and MEME.GRGR_CK=SBSB.GRGR_CK
	JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD  on SBSB.SBSB_CK=SBAD.SBSB_CK and SBSB.GRGR_CK=SBAD.GRGR_CK and SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_HOME=SBAD.SBAD_TYPE
	JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC PLDS  on MEPE.CSPI_ID=PLDS.CSPI_ID
	JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_PDDS_PROD_DESC PDDS  on MEPE.PDPD_ID=PDDS.PDPD_ID
	JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_CSCS_CLASS CSCS  on MEPE.CSCS_ID = CSCS.CSCS_ID and MEPE.GRGR_CK = CSCS.GRGR_CK
	LEFT JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR  on MEPE.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK
	LEFT JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_SGSG_SUB_GROUP SGSG  on MEPE.SGSG_CK=SGSG.SGSG_CK	and MEPE.GRGR_CK=SGSG.GRGR_CK
	LEFT JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEPR_PRIM_PROV MEPR  on MEPE.MEME_CK=MEPR.MEME_CK and (@CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN MEPR.MEPR_EFF_DT and MEPR.MEPR_TERM_DT) and MEPE.GRGR_CK=MEPR.GRGR_CK
	LEFT JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CER_ATXR_ATTACH_U ATXR  on ATXR.ATXR_SOURCE_ID = SBSB.ATXR_SOURCE_ID AND ATXR.ATSY_ID = 'RPD'
	LEFT JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CER_ATUF_USERFLD_D ATUF  on ATXR.ATSY_ID = ATUF.ATSY_ID AND ATXR.ATXR_DEST_ID = ATUF.ATXR_DEST_ID
	WHERE (MEPE.CSCS_ID like 'CD%' or MEPE.CSCS_ID like 'PL%' or MEPE.CSCS_ID like 'CO%' or MEPE.CSCS_ID like 'FC%' or MEPE.CSCS_ID like 'KD%' or MEPE.CSCS_ID like 'CS%' or MEPE.CSCS_ID like 'KS%')'
